FST-060.title: Nuts and tapped parts sit on the threaded part of a partly threaded screw
FST-060.scope: ISO 4762 cap screws; T-nut screws (nut not drawn) and screws declared meta['fully_threaded'] are skipped

FST-070.title: A locking provision that does not depend on preload on moving or vibrating assemblies
FST-070.scope: moving body or holding a motor; declared by add_screw/add_nut(locking=...) or a join naming a locknut / adhesive

BLT-010.title: At least 6 teeth in mesh on every load-carrying sprocket
BLT-010.scope: every loaded pulley except a joint's drive pulley, which motion.belt_low_wrap already judges

BLT-011.title: At least 60 degrees of wrap on every loaded sprocket

BLT-030.title: Back-side idlers are flat and uncrowned

BLT-040.title: Pulley diameter not smaller than the belt width

BRG-020.title: Retain the bearing axially on both faces of both rings
BRG-020.scope: something must stand against each face (0.4 mm); whether it is fixed to the right part is not judged

BRG-023.title: Axial load through a shoulder, collar or circlip, not set-screw friction
BRG-023.scope: flags an inner-ring face whose only abutment is a set-screwed hub on the shaft

SHF-010.title: Set screws bear on a flat and are locked
SHF-010.scope: declare d.join(hub, shaft, 'set_screw on flat, threadlocked') when both are true

SHF-011.title: Never seat a set screw or a bearing on a thread
SHF-011.scope: lead screws (T8) without meta['journal'] on the screw part

FST-051.title: A joint needs two fasteners or one plus an anti-rotation feature
FST-051.scope: pairs of parts joined by one screw and nothing else; T-nut screws are FST-101's

FST-101.title: A part on T-nuts wants two of them (or a key in the slot)

FST-050.title: Edge distance of fastener holes at least 1.5 d

FST-020.title: Clearance holes to ISO 273; choose the class deliberately
FST-020.scope: under fine in a metal part is a warning; larger than coarse under a bare head is info (the seat itself is ratings' FST-031)

FST-034.title: Leave at least 1 d of floor under a counterbored head

FST-081.title: No look-alike lengths of one size into blind catalogue threads

LOC-006.title: Every adjustment has a mover, a lock and access
LOC-006.scope: mover and lock are read from Adjustment(mover=, lock=); access in the finished machine is not checked; z_offset (firmware) and float adjustments need no lock

FST-072.title: Nylon-insert lock nuts only below about 120 degC
FST-072.scope: a screw or nut declared nyloc whose stack touches a part with meta['service_temp_c'] over the limit (limit 'FST-072.max_temp_c', default 120) or a hotend / heater part

FST-040.title: State a tightening torque for every structural joint
FST-040.scope: with DOC-012: a generated torque and locking table (metrics.practice.torque_table)

DOC-012.title: Torque and threadlocker call-outs in the build instructions
DOC-012.scope: the table is in the metrics; BUILD.md does not yet print it

DG-01.title: No 3D-printed part in a load path unless waived with a reason
DG-01.scope: carries a guide, bearing, lead-screw nut or screw, motor (incl. an extruder), belt tension (pulley, idler, belt clamp), the bed, or a part declared meta['load_path']; by a shared screw, a declared join or contact. Contact is not a load path where the clamp goes through a metal sleeve declared in the printed part (a join) and the printed part touches neither the head nor its washers

DG-02.title: No tapped thread in aluminium we make; no tapped extrusion ends
DG-02.scope: accepted: a through-bolt and nut, add_screw(insert='steel' | 'pem'), a T-nut

DG-03.title: A machined part with only through-features is a 2D laser-cut candidate
DG-03.scope: 2.5D profile, no blind pocket, counterbore or countersink, no fitted bore; meta['cnc_reason'] records why not

DG-04.title: No thread in a printed part: through-bolt with nut and washers; heat-set insert only with a reason
DG-04.scope: a screw that threads into a printed part (tapped, self-tapped or a heat-set insert): warning, error when the joint is in a load path (DG-01's load parts); accepted: add_screw(..., insert=True, insert_reason='...') or a DG-04 waiver. Covers FST-090 (screws straight into plastic)

DG-05.title: Printed clearance holes: ISO 273 medium plus the FDM allowance
DG-05.scope: smallest section of the hole under medium + allowance (0.2 vertical / 0.3 in the build plane, limits 'DG-05.allowance_vertical_mm' / 'DG-05.allowance_in_plane_mm'), or over coarse + 0.4 under a bare head or nut; the metal-part classes stay FST-020's

DG-06.title: Every fastener is a drawn part: the BOM and the model list the same hardware
DG-06.scope: hardware_bom_only: a screw, nut, washer, T-nut, insert or clinch nut that is only a BOM line (design.bom_extra); hardware_count_mismatch: a hardware SKU whose BOM quantity is not the number of parts drawn; tnut_not_drawn / tnut_without_screw: a tnut=True screw without its T-nut part, or the reverse; joint_without_fasteners: a declared join whose kind names a fastener (m5_tnut, through_bolt, bolted...) with no drawn fastener holding both parts. Set screws inside a bought pulley's hub are listed (metrics), not required as parts

FST-031.title: Washer under any head or nut on a slot or oversize hole

PRT-030.title: No preloaded seat on printed plastic without washer and sleeve

FST-030.title: Head and nut pressure under the seat's limiting surface pressure

FST-090.title: Screws driven straight into printed plastic are for one-time, low-load joints

FST-012.title: Screw shorter than a catalogue part's tapped depth

SHT-014.title: Deburr / edge-finish note on sheet parts

DOC-010.title: Edge-break note on every made metal part
DOC-010.checked_by: manufacture.edges (edge_break_mm on the part or design.manufacturing)

SHT-013.title: Round the outside corners of sheet profiles

BRG-024.title: What abuts a bearing ring stays inside that ring's abutment diameters

BRG-022.title: Axial load on a small bearing under 0.25 C0

LSC-015.title: Several screws on one body: budget their lead difference

BLT-010d.title: Teeth in mesh on a joint's drive pulley

BLT-041.title: Flanges on belt pulleys
BLT-041.reason: every catalogue GT2 pulley and idler is drawn double-flanged, so there is nothing to find until an unflanged part exists

FST-052.title: No sustained shear on screw friction when a stop can carry it
FST-052.reason: needs the service load across each slotted joint (belt pull on a motor mount, etc.), which no design declares

STR-013.title: Friction joints: check slip
STR-013.reason: as FST-052: no declared shear load per joint

FST-100.title: T-nut type against assembly order
FST-100.checked_by: interference.tslot_screws (tnut_needs_end_loading) and assemblability (a drawn drop-in T-nut goes in through its slot's opening only, before what covers it); only in designs with design.tnut_style set
